provenance.notes: Installed per project with claude plugin marketplace add remotion-dev/claude-code-plugin, then claude plugin install remotion@remotion --scope project. Provenance only; no files are copied. License MIT as declared in the plugin's plugin.json and marketplace.json (the repo has no LICENSE file); rendering with the remotion npm packages falls under the Remotion License instead. Plugin version 4.0.529, 12 skills, same set as remotion-dev/skills@cf49eff. Enabled only in project-templates/video/.claude/settings.json, whose extraKnownMarketplaces declares the remotion marketplace.
Plugin 4.0.534: same 12 skills; preview-first guidance, render only on explicit request.
